sections.heading: Federal premium tax credit rules
sections.intro: 2026 and 2027 marketplace plan years have different 400% FPL one-person references ($62,600 and $63,840 respectively). Income alone does not establish PTC eligibility. Dated source table.

sections.heading: 2027 benchmark Silver contribution schedules (only for eligible enrollees)
The California Premium Subsidy (state money)
sections.note: California's 2027 state help reaches 200% FPL for eligible marketplace enrollees; it supplements federal APTC, not an automatic plan for anyone disqualified from Medi-Cal. DHCS notice.
